resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register, FireLookout.com and the 2017 trip report give 1968; the Oregon Lookouts history page gives 1969 for burning by a forestry crew. The story reports both.
The register and the trip report describe a cabin here from 1917; a July 1930 newspaper item says the point had never had a lookout building and the lookout used a tent.

notes_for_editor: Not the Devils Peak near Mount Hood (us-or-devils-peak). The Mountaineers page found in search describes that Hood-area peak and was not used. Agency naming differs: Rogue River/Winema (register), Crater then Rogue River (history page). The 2017 trip report is a hiker's account, not an agency record. No source states current public access. The 1917 cabin claim is contested. Revision 2026-10-09: the 1930 building is described as on its way (will arrive July 24), the 1968 removal is of the L-4 cab, and the 1963 snowbound item now has an evidence entry.
